svg.title: How should a neuron explanation be tested?
svg.desc: Proposed tests for this review, not completed experiments. Discover an explanation, predict activation on prespecified held-out inputs, intervene with controls, then evaluate behavior and circuit claims. Compare native neurons with sparse-autoencoder features under matched conditions; use failures to revise the next hypothesis.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: How should a neuron explanation be tested?

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Ask whether a readable explanation predicts activations and behavior.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · Discover, then fix the hypothesis

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Propose a rule from exploratory examples.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Set predictions before seeing the test inputs.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: 2 · Predict activations on new inputs

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Include positives, counterexamples, weak activations and OOD.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Predict position, sign and magnitude—not just a label.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: 3 · Intervene with controls

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Test ablation, patching and replacement with predicted values.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Check intervention strength, side effects and control edits.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: 4 · Evaluate behavior and circuit claims

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Compare output distributions, task results and circuit links.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Use successful and failed conditions to revise the explanation.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Compare both representations under matched conditions

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Match inputs, budgets, metrics and corresponding interventions.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Report SAE reconstruction error and each method's scope.

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Failed examples → more specific hypotheses and tests

text.font-family: 'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans CJK KR','Noto Sans KR',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Proposed tests · Sources: Goodfire; Gao; Bills et al.; Circuit Tracing
